blocks.title: Protection at every turn.
blocks.text: Simply comfortable on your feet: ihle® diabetic socks complete your orthopaedic footwear. The medical-grade knit fabric feels like a second skin. It fits perfectly, yet offers ample freedom of movement and toe room. The specially designed cuff and carefully selected materials prevent pressure points, inflammation and injuries.

blocks.title: Running comfort in colour.
blocks.text: What good is a custom-made shoe if the sock wrinkles? ihle® encourages patients and orthopaedic shoemakers to think beyond the shoe itself when it comes to orthopaedic footwear. That is why ihle® diabetic socks have neither an irritating seam nor any other constricting areas.

list: in a wide selection of colours
in different fits (from narrow to lymphoedema)
as socks for forefoot amputations (Lisfranc, Chopart, Pirogoff)

UNDERWEAR.tagline: Better body awareness in the brace

blocks.title: Improved body awareness. Greater acceptance of wearing the garment.
blocks.text: Soothing and protective for the skin: ihle® corset shirts were developed as an essential part of conservative scoliosis treatment. The medical-grade knit fabric fits like a glove, without bothersome creases or irritating seams. They complement corset treatment and reduce the suffering of the often very young patients.

blocks.title: Fashionable and functional bodywear.
blocks.text: Scoliosis, brace therapy and growing up: this combination is often difficult to manage. With this in mind, we have tailored our products to the lifestyle of teenagers. Whether spaghetti straps or off-the-shoulder, short- or long-sleeved, boat neck, V-neck or crew neck: ihle® brace shirts are available in various styles or as custom-made pieces. The high-quality fibre blend conforms to the body and moves with you.

PROTHETIC.tagline: Stay in motion without pressure points

blocks.title: Stay in motion without pressure points.
blocks.text: Whether after amputation or during rehabilitation: when a prosthesis or orthosis is prescribed, a treatment goal comes with it. The patient should be able to stand again or be as active as possible, without pain. For these high-quality assistive devices and stump fittings, ihle® manufactures the protective undergarments: medical knits for sensitive areas of the body.

blocks.title: Made to measure. Available immediately from stock.
blocks.text: No matter what type of orthotic device is being considered, ihle® products impress with their fit, function and quality. They noticeably improve wearing comfort. Acceptance of the prosthesis or orthosis increases, as does the desired treatment effect. We give our best to achieve this: skin-friendly materials, high-quality yarns and a wealth of textile expertise.

lines: Lower leg stump stockings for pin systems

ILO.tagline: A companion for indoors and outdoors

blocks.title: A companion for indoors and outdoors.
blocks.text: Functional socks and stockings have become established in both business and leisure. People appreciate the impeccable fit, the comfortable feel and the excellent foot climate. ihle® has developed everyday socks from the potential of medical knitwear that can handle virtually anything. Whether a meeting, a mountain hike or a dance class: no pinching or slipping, just pure comfort.

blocks.title: Goodbye sweaty feet.
blocks.text: Moisture outwards, warmth inwards: angora, terry cloth and virgin wool guarantee comfort from calf to toe. All ilo® products are a treat for your feet and look great in sneakers, dress shoes, running shoes or hiking boots. Durable, intelligent materials and a specially knitted ribbed cuff withstand even many washes. You have our word on it!

banner.text: Warmth in winter, comfort and hygiene in summer: as temperatures rise, our choice of socks changes too. ihle® has adapted its product range accordingly and makes socks in three different styles.

short.title: Short socks
short.text: A versatile sock for every season: the leg gives the sock its shape and its name. On short socks it reaches about 10 cm above the ankle, roughly to the middle of the calf. The top can be a simple, non-elastic edge or a ribbed cuff – with or without elastic.

footlet.title: Footlets
footlet.text: The summer version of the sock mainly covers the toes and heel. The foot part ends just above or below the ankle. For people with diabetes we therefore recommend the longer versions of our socks.

knee.title: Knee-high socks
knee.text: A classic for winter or with high shoes: the sock ends below the knee. A wide top gives a secure hold without constricting. Elastic and non-elastic tops are also available.

colors.title: Colours
colors.text: Shoes are becoming more and more colourful. From subtle natural tones to expressive colours, ihle® combines textile expertise with modern colour design.

hero.text: Carefully selected yarns of cotton, wool and functional fibres – for wearing comfort, durability and reliable performance.
hero.imageAlt: Yarn cones in natural white, green and rust next to a knitted blanket

intro.text: At ihle®, we combine carefully selected natural and functional fibres with modern knitting technology to create socks and medical knitwear that offer lasting comfort, a perfect fit and dependable quality – for every season and every need.

fibres.title: Carefully selected fibres
fibres.text: Natural and functional fibres, chosen to suit each use.

quality.title: Dependable quality
quality.text: Consistent workmanship that specialist retailers can rely on.

comfort.title: Comfortable for everyday wear
comfort.text: Soft, seamless knits that do not press or dig in.

durable.title: Durable and dimensionally stable
durable.text: Made to keep their fit and feel for a long time.

knit.text: Crucial for both feel and appearance is not only the material used, but also the gauge. It states how many needles knit per inch (2.54 cm). A gauge of 14 stitches per inch is common and gives the classic stitch pattern. ihle® works with 6 to 36 stitches per inch – the result is always a knit that matches the requirement exactly.
knit.gaugeLabel: Gauge at ihle: 6 to 36 stitches per inch. Classic is 14, extra fine is 22.

smooth.title: Classic smooth
smooth.text: This evenly knit fabric in medium thickness is a true all-rounder: for every season, every occasion, for women and men. ihle® uses it to make everyday socks and stockings.

fine.title: Classic extra fine
fine.text: This is what ihle® calls the refined version of its classic knit. In Central Europe this quality is mostly preferred by women, in Southern Europe more often by men.

plush.title: Full plush
plush.text: From toe to cuff: fully padded socks give pleasant warmth, effective cushioning and good air circulation thanks to their terry knit – for all kinds of activities.

semi.tag: Padded at toes, sole and heel
semi.title: Semi-plush
semi.text: Padding where it counts: sometimes extra padding at the toes, sole and heel is enough. Semi-plush models are therefore ideal companions for the seasons in between.

next.title: Another section follows
next.text: This area is temporary and will be replaced by the next part of the material page.

cuffs.text: Stretchy, supple and suitable for everyday wear – that is how knitwear should fit. ihle® has therefore developed various cuff and hem styles, from narrow to extra wide.

loop.title: Loop cuff without elastic
loop.text: With this special knit, ihle® primarily meets the needs of diabetics. Anyone who finds constricting elastic bothersome also benefits from this cuff.

ribLong.title: Ribbed cuff without elastic
ribLong.text: This cuff is about 10 cm long and can also be worn folded over.

ribShort.title: Ribbed cuff with elastic
ribShort.text: Here, 4 cm of elastic is knitted in. Customers with healthy feet usually prefer the added support. Good to know: this cuff is not suitable for diabetics.

footer.newsletterTitle: Stay informed about new products, materials and innovations
footer.about: Whether diabetic shoes, corsets, orthoses or prostheses: ihle® is convinced that orthopaedic care goes beyond the aid itself. On this basis we developed knitted fabrics that offer reliable protection. Such precisely fitting textiles not only increase wearing comfort, they also improve quality of life and treatment results.
footer.hours: Monday to Friday: 8:00 am to 3:00 pm
